about_short_description.short_description: Bexel is a software company that helps inspection companies digitize their entire inspection process, go paperless.

product.name: Bexel Inspection Software
product.description: Cloud-based software for managing and digitizing inspection, testing, and certification workflows, ensuring compliance and operational control.

product.name: Asset Management Module
product.description: Software module for real-time tracking, management, and maintenance of assets using NFC tags, QR codes, and geo-location.

product.name: Batch Rig Inspection Module
product.description: Module to manage bulk equipment inspections and certifications with automated data import, error detection, and certificate generation.

product.name: Drops Inspection Module
product.description: Module for conducting and managing drops inspections using predefined checklists and corrective action tracking.

product.name: Lifting Inspection Module
product.description: Software module to manage lifting and rigging equipment inspections compliant with LEEA and LOLER standards.

product.name: Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Inspection Module
product.description: Module to organize and control end-to-end NDT workflows and reporting according to industry standards like ASNT.
